prompts.canal:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a painted 2.5D RPG world background, no interface.
Input image: the supplied canal-route.webp is the EDIT TARGET. Edit this exact image, retain its recognizable composition. Output one landscape image at 1536x1024.
Primary request: expand the walkable safe garden exploration routes with broad, visibly connected stone paving. Retain the main diagonal elevated boulevard at exactly its current location, running from approximately (250,680), through (800,430), to (1400,130) in 1536x1024 image coordinates. Preserve the arrival plaza around (220,745), lower-right circular plaza around (1050,630), existing far-right plaza around (1360,430), and far top-right road, with their existing clear connections.
Change only these garden side-route regions: (1) Add a broad coherent western garden loop upward from the arrival/workshop quarter around (220,745) through (210,556) to the planted terrace around (180,220). It must visibly join the original arrival paving and existing northwest terrace stair landing: connected, continuous, unobstructed stone floor, at least 70–100 pixels visually wide. Expand or restructure the left waterside building edge/terraces only where needed to make this route obvious. (2) Make a quiet open rooftop/greenhouse garden terrace around (560,205), with a spacious open stone floor surrounded by flowers and greenhouse architecture, and connect it by a broad diagonal stone branch bridge toward the original main boulevard around (700,450). The bridge must visibly touch both floor surfaces with real wide landings, continuous paving and matched elevations; no water gap, wall across the route, or concealed entrance. (3) A larger planted terrace around (950,330) can add a northern bridge loop to the preserved east plaza at (1360,430). Keep side paths equally broad and clearly accessible; use wide gentle steps where required by elevation.
Style and invariants: match the original premium Torchlight-like hand-painted detailed game world, fixed elevated isometric camera and exact framing, rich warm sun from upper left, glowing teal canals, aged stone paving, gold-green foliage and flowers, detailed garden and greenhouse architecture. Preserve existing main paving, plazas, boats, water channels and overall layout wherever they do not conflict with the explicitly requested new side routes. Canals remain visibly canals outside the new bridges; plenty of water must remain. Wide open walkways are readable gameplay floor. No narrow one-person passages.
Avoid: any text, labels, letters, signage, characters, people, monsters, gates, loot, items, UI, HUD, markers, arrows, magical portals, watermarks, diagram overlays. Do not change the camera, crop, overall palette, or replace the entire scene with a new design.

groundScrap.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a small transparent PNG ground pickup for a premium painted 2.5D RPG.
Primary request: one single compact low flat isometric heap of valuable salvaged metal lying on the ground. Include a few weathered copper and steel fragments, one short dark cable, a few nuts and bolts, and one tiny teal shard. Make this read clearly when scaled down to 40–50 pixels in game: simple strong compact silhouette, chunky recognizable metal pieces, very few small details. No container.
Style/medium: premium Torchlight-like hand-painted RPG world art, warm golden sun from upper left, copper highlights, cool blue-grey steel shadows, aged metal brushwork. Match the gentle elevated isometric view of a painted garden RPG, viewed from above at roughly 35 degrees. Low horizontal ground heap, no tall object.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered heap, modest clean transparent margin on all sides. A square transparent image. All background pixels must be genuinely transparent. No environment, no paving, no ground tile or platform. Tiny soft contact shading contained tightly within the heap silhouette is okay.
Avoid: chest, box, sack, armor, weapon, coin pile, text, letters, UI badge, interface, icon border, markers, circular base, glowing circular base, halo, magical glow, beams, floor, background color, characters, monsters, watermark, multiple separate piles.
